description: Check one email address before you send to it: syntax, whether the domain accepts mail (MX, null MX or implicit A record), a disposable-domain flag (public CC0 list of about 9,900 domains), a role-account flag (info@, support@, noreply@...) and a free-provider flag. Returns a verdict of ok, risky or undeliverable with plain reasons. Use validate_email first if you only need syntax. No SMTP probe is made and no mail is sent, so it cannot confirm the mailbox exists. The address is not stored or logged. Read-only; one live DNS lookup via Cloudflare DoH. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or a DNS failure returns an error and is not charged.

email.description: Email address to check, e.g. jane@example.com

name: check_email_address
